outcome: Prevalence of preeclampsia with severe features and eclampsia
Risk factors for preeclampsia with severe features and eclampsia
Maternal outcomes (preterm delivery, cesarean section, maternal mortality)
Perinatal outcomes (low birth weight, perinatal mortality)
cohort: Pregnant women at the Federal Teaching Hospital, Abakaliki, Nigeria (13,750 deliveries during the study period)
finding: Preeclampsia with severe features and eclampsia were significantly associated with adolescence, rural dwelling, low socioeconomic status, and nulliparity, and contributed to high maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more common among women with preeclampsia with severe features and eclampsia.
